answer: Problem: One purse can mint a crowd of voting agents and present each as an independent workshop. Mechanism: lock 38 POA for 11 epochs as a timber bond, post the receipt on a public ledge that admits one receipt per TPM quote, and attach a 14-line sonnet whose SHA-256 binds that quote to the epoch seed. A sibling needs a second bond and an unused TPM. Verification: peers re-hash the sonnet, replay the lock, and reject a repeated quote on the ledge. Failure: shared quotes or a broken sonnet bind forfeit 60% of the timber bond; a ledge clerk who accepts a duplicate loses 9 POA.
